operations.name: inner join
preconditions: both key functions return the same semantic key type
one equality relation and missing-key policy are explicit
output-field collisions are resolved by the projection
postconditions: every output pair satisfies the declared key equality
no unmatched input occurrence appears in the output
bag multiplicities are preserved for every matching pair
diagnostics state unmatched and cardinality counts
laws: for matching occurrences l and r, output multiplicity equals multiplicity(l) multiplied by multiplicity(r)
inner join is commutative only up to an explicit field-swap isomorphism
inner join is not generally associative when projections, coercions or missing-key policies differ
partitioned and single-node evaluation are equivalent under the same equality and bag semantics
failures: provider violates declared equality or multiplicity semantics
resource_model: state is proportional to the build side unless a provider proves another bound
spill and skew policy must be declared
gaps: null and missing-key algebra requires final adjudication
streaming retractions require a separate mode profile

operations.name: temporal as-of join
preconditions: left observation time and right validity intervals use compatible clocks and precision
boundary inclusivity is explicit
overlapping right-side versions are prohibited or have an explicit deterministic tie-break
stream mode declares watermark, lateness and correction behavior
postconditions: every left occurrence produces exactly one output containing zero or one selected right version
a selected right version has the same key and contains the left observation time under declared interval boundaries
diagnostics identify missing and ambiguous temporal matches
laws: reordering inputs does not change results after applying the same declared temporal order
batch and finalized-stream results agree after the watermark and correction horizon close
recording-time changes never masquerade as valid-time changes
refusals: missing finality policy in stream mode
resource_model: retained right-side history is bounded by declared validity and correction horizons
provider_requirements: watermark and late-data support where streamed
gaps: edition must select half-open or alternate interval convention
bitemporal as-of is a separate operation

operations.name: stream deduplicate
preconditions: deduplication key is stable
winner/merge policy is deterministic
retention and late-data horizon are explicit
postconditions: at most one current winner exists per retained key
every suppressed occurrence is represented in duplicate evidence
late superior winners retract or correct prior output according to policy
laws: replay with the same events, event-time order and policy produces the same changelog
state eviction makes guarantees beyond the retention horizon explicitly weaker
delivery exactly-once is not implied by semantic deduplication
refusals: unbounded retention without an approved resource profile
resource_model: state cardinality is bounded by distinct retained keys
precharge storage for the declared retention horizon
gaps: probabilistic deduplication requires a separate approximate contract

operations.name: convert unit
preconditions: source and target units have the same physical dimension
conversion path and numeric precision policy are explicit
context-dependent units carry required context
postconditions: physical quantity is preserved within declared numeric error
target unit identity is attached
conversion path and precision loss are evidenced
laws: identity conversion is identity
composition of exact conversions equals direct exact conversion
round-trip conversion is bounded by declared numeric error
currency conversion is not unit conversion and requires valid-time market authority
resource_model: constant space per scalar; vectorized providers declare batch bounds
gaps: calendar durations and nominal quantities require separate semantic profiles

operations.name: reconcile balances
preconditions: both populations and as-of boundary are explicit
quantity dimensions and units are compatible
one-to-one, one-to-many and partial-match precedence is explicit
tolerance has authority and purpose
postconditions: every input occurrence is matched, partially matched or unmatched exactly once
matched plus residual amounts conserve each input amount
every break has a typed reason and evidence
control totals before and after reconciliation are reported
laws: reordering inputs does not change match groups
zero tolerance never authorizes a nonzero difference
waiver changes disposition but not observed difference
reconciliation does not mutate source facts
failures: input changed during an unversioned run
resource_model: candidate matching may be quadratic unless key/index constraints provide a bound
gaps: domain-specific break disposition belongs to vertical packs

operations.name: resume change offset
preconditions: offset is bound to the exact source identity and log epoch
caller is authorized
offset remains inside source retention
capture contract declares inclusive or exclusive resume
postconditions: receipt identifies requested and effective offset
no delivery before or after the boundary is hidden
source gaps and rewinds are explicit outcomes
laws: resume alone does not provide exactly-once processing
an offset from another source identity or epoch is never silently accepted
repeated idempotent requests yield equivalent effective boundaries while retained
resource_model: connection, source quota and downstream backpressure budgets are explicit
gaps: transaction-consistent resume across multiple source partitions needs a separate coordinator contract

operations.name: commit table snapshot
preconditions: proposed metadata is internally valid
all referenced immutable data and metadata objects exist
expected base snapshot is explicit
commit authority covers the table
commit identity is unique
postconditions: catalog authority points atomically to the committed metadata or remains unchanged
committed snapshot and receipt have stable identities
repeating a successful commit identity returns the same result
uncommitted objects are not presented as table state
laws: a conflicting base snapshot never silently overwrites concurrent state
snapshot history is immutable
physical cleanup is separate from logical commit
commit receipt identifies the linearization point or states that the provider cannot prove one
refusals: duplicate commit identity with different content
resource_model: metadata and catalog request budgets are bounded
orphan cleanup is a separate eventual process
gaps: multi-table atomic commit requires a separate transaction contract

operations.name: evaluate formula
preconditions: formula is typechecked
every free reference is bound
function registry and numeric policy editions are fixed
all time/locale/unit contexts are explicit
postconditions: outcome is a value or a typed refusal, never an implicit null
trace identifies formula, bindings, functions and numeric policy
no external effect occurs
laws: same formula, bindings and evaluation context produce the same outcome
alpha-renaming bound references does not change outcome
undefined and error are distinct outcomes
provider-specific functions cannot enter a published formula without a portability qualification
resource_model: evaluation steps, recursion depth, memory and numeric precision are precharged
gaps: array, lazy and iterative fixed-point evaluation need explicit applicability profiles

operations.name: bitemporal correction
preconditions: fact identity and valid-time assertion are explicit
recording instant is monotone for the authority stream
correction authority and reason are present
idempotency identity is unique
postconditions: prior recorded assertions remain queryable
new recording-time knowledge is appended
valid-time history reflects the new assertion when queried as known after the recording instant
receipt links superseded and new assertions
laws: correction never rewrites what was recorded as known earlier
as-known-at queries before the recording instant are unchanged
repeating the same correction identity is idempotent
valid time and recording time never substitute for one another
refusals: duplicate correction identity with different assertion
resource_model: history retention and correction fan-out are governed explicitly
gaps: domain-specific recall and downstream restatement policies remain outside this operation

operations.name: run heuristic
preconditions: problem and heuristic capability classes are compatible
hard constraints have executable feasibility oracles
time/iteration/memory budget is explicit
random seed policy is explicit
postconditions: outcome distinguishes feasible incumbent, no incumbent, proven infeasible only when evidence supports it, cancellation and failure
every returned incumbent passes the declared feasibility oracle
receipt contains budget consumed, seed, versions, objective trace and any bound/gap evidence
laws: heuristic success never implies optimality
absence of an incumbent never implies infeasibility
same deterministic provider, seed and budget profile must be replayable within declared reproducibility tolerance
timeout with incumbent differs from timeout without incumbent
resource_model: time, iterations, memory, parallelism and external evaluations are finite precharged budgets
gaps: distributed nondeterministic search requires a separate reproducibility profile
